method: Manually reviewed root-cause classifications based on saved historical diagnostics. Counts are generated from source JSON.

classifications.question: Show five albums and the artists who created them.
classifications.rationale: Extra ID column and differing output names.
classifications.generated_sql: SELECT Album.AlbumId, Album.Title, Artist.Name AS ArtistName FROM Album JOIN Artist ON Album.ArtistId = Artist.ArtistId ORDER BY Album.Title LIMIT 5
expected_rows: 20th Century Masters - The Millennium Collection: The Best of Scorpions
A Matter of Life and Death
actual_rows: 20th Century Masters - The Millennium Collection: The Best of Scorpions
A Matter of Life and Death

classifications.question: Show five tracks priced at 99 cents.
classifications.rationale: Five matching tracks requested without defining which five.
classifications.generated_sql: SELECT TrackId, Name, UnitPrice AS track_price FROM Track WHERE UnitPrice = 0.99 ORDER BY TrackId LIMIT 5
expected_rows: "Eine Kleine Nachtmusik" Serenade In G, K. 525: I. Allegro
actual_rows: For Those About To Rock (We Salute You)

classifications.question: What was the total invoice revenue for each month of 2013?
classifications.rationale: Revenue alias differs; both result sets are empty.
classifications.generated_sql: SELECT STRFTIME('%Y-%m', Invoice.InvoiceDate) AS month, ROUND(SUM(Invoice.Total), 2) AS total_revenue FROM Invoice WHERE Invoice.InvoiceDate >= '2013-01-01' AND Invoice.InvoiceDate < '2014-01-01' GROUP BY month ORDER BY month LIMIT 100

classifications.question: Which five billing countries generated the most invoice revenue?
classifications.rationale: Revenue values match, but column names differ.
classifications.generated_sql: SELECT BillingCountry, ROUND(SUM(Total), 2) AS total_revenue FROM Invoice GROUP BY BillingCountry ORDER BY total_revenue DESC, BillingCountry ASC LIMIT 5

classifications.question: Which five music genres have the most tracks?
classifications.rationale: Genre values and counts match; genre alias differs.
classifications.generated_sql: SELECT Genre.Name AS genre_name, COUNT(Track.TrackId) AS track_count FROM Genre JOIN Track ON Track.GenreId = Genre.GenreId GROUP BY Genre.GenreId, Genre.Name ORDER BY track_count DESC LIMIT 5

classifications.question: Which five artists have the most albums?
classifications.rationale: Correct top artists and counts, but extra ID and different alias.
classifications.generated_sql: SELECT Artist.ArtistId, Artist.Name AS artist_name, COUNT(Album.AlbumId) AS album_count FROM Artist LEFT JOIN Album ON Album.ArtistId = Artist.ArtistId GROUP BY Artist.ArtistId, Artist.Name ORDER BY album_count DESC, artist_name ASC LIMIT 5

classifications.question: What is the average track length in minutes for each of the five longest-average genres?
classifications.rationale: Values match, but output column names differ.
classifications.generated_sql: SELECT Genre.Name AS genre_name, ROUND(AVG(Track.Milliseconds) / 60000.0, 2) AS avg_length_minutes FROM Track JOIN Genre ON Track.GenreId = Genre.GenreId GROUP BY Genre.GenreId, Genre.Name ORDER BY avg_length_minutes DESC LIMIT 5

classifications.question: Which five artists generated the most revenue from sold tracks?
classifications.rationale: Correct top artists and revenue, but an extra ID column.
classifications.generated_sql: SELECT Artist.ArtistId, Artist.Name AS artist_name, ROUND(SUM(InvoiceLine.UnitPrice * InvoiceLine.Quantity), 2) AS revenue FROM Artist JOIN Album ON Album.ArtistId = Artist.ArtistId JOIN Track ON Track.AlbumId = Album.AlbumId JOIN InvoiceLine ON InvoiceLine.TrackId = Track.TrackId GROUP BY Artist.ArtistId, Artist.Name ORDER BY revenue DESC, artist_name LIMIT 5

classifications.question: Show five tracks that have never appeared on an invoice.
classifications.rationale: Five qualifying tracks requested without defining which five.
classifications.generated_sql: SELECT Track.TrackId AS track_id, Track.Name AS track_name FROM Track LEFT JOIN InvoiceLine ON InvoiceLine.TrackId = Track.TrackId WHERE InvoiceLine.InvoiceLineId IS NULL ORDER BY Track.TrackId LIMIT 5
expected_rows: "Eine Kleine Nachtmusik" Serenade In G, K. 525: I. Allegro
(I Can't Help) Falling In Love With You

classifications.question: Which five tracks have sold the most units?
classifications.rationale: Correct tracks and counts, but extra ID and different aliases.
classifications.generated_sql: SELECT Track.TrackId, Track.Name, SUM(InvoiceLine.Quantity) AS total_units_sold FROM Track JOIN InvoiceLine ON Track.TrackId = InvoiceLine.TrackId GROUP BY Track.TrackId, Track.Name ORDER BY total_units_sold DESC, Track.Name LIMIT 5

classifications.question: How much line-item revenue has each genre generated?
classifications.rationale: Column names and genre labels differ; a zero-revenue row also differs.
classifications.generated_sql: SELECT g.Name AS Genre, ROUND(SUM(COALESCE(il.UnitPrice * il.Quantity, 0)), 2) AS TotalRevenue FROM Genre AS g LEFT JOIN Track AS t ON t.GenreId = g.GenreId LEFT JOIN InvoiceLine AS il ON il.TrackId = t.TrackId GROUP BY g.Name ORDER BY TotalRevenue DESC LIMIT 100

classifications.question: How many customers does each employee support?
classifications.rationale: First/last name columns are reversed and ordering differs.
classifications.generated_sql: SELECT Employee.EmployeeId, Employee.LastName, Employee.FirstName, COUNT(Customer.CustomerId) AS customer_count FROM Employee LEFT JOIN Customer ON Customer.SupportRepId = Employee.EmployeeId GROUP BY Employee.EmployeeId, Employee.LastName, Employee.FirstName ORDER BY Employee.LastName, Employee.FirstName LIMIT 100

classifications.question: How many invoices were issued in each year?
classifications.rationale: Year values and counts match; year alias differs.
classifications.generated_sql: SELECT STRFTIME('%Y', Invoice.InvoiceDate) AS invoice_year, COUNT(*) AS invoice_count FROM Invoice GROUP BY invoice_year ORDER BY invoice_year LIMIT 100

classifications.question: Show the five most expensive tracks.
classifications.rationale: Correct tracks and prices, but an extra ID column.
classifications.generated_sql: SELECT TrackId, Name, UnitPrice FROM Track ORDER BY UnitPrice DESC, Name ASC LIMIT 5

classifications.question: Which five playlists contain the most tracks?
classifications.rationale: Correct playlist counts, but extra ID and different output names.
classifications.generated_sql: SELECT Playlist.PlaylistId, Playlist.Name, COUNT(PlaylistTrack.TrackId) AS track_count FROM Playlist LEFT JOIN PlaylistTrack ON Playlist.PlaylistId = PlaylistTrack.PlaylistId GROUP BY Playlist.PlaylistId, Playlist.Name ORDER BY track_count DESC, Playlist.Name ASC LIMIT 5

classifications.question: Which albums contain more than 20 tracks?
classifications.rationale: The query omits the required track count from its output.
classifications.generated_sql: SELECT Album.AlbumId AS album_id, Album.Title AS album_title FROM Album JOIN Track ON Track.AlbumId = Album.AlbumId GROUP BY Album.AlbumId, Album.Title HAVING COUNT(Track.TrackId) > 20 ORDER BY Album.Title LIMIT 100
expected_rows: My Way: The Best Of Frank Sinatra [Disc 1]
Instant Karma: The Amnesty International Campaign to Save Darfur
actual_rows: Instant Karma: The Amnesty International Campaign to Save Darfur
My Way: The Best Of Frank Sinatra [Disc 1]

classifications.question: Which customers have spent more than 40 dollars in total invoice amounts?
classifications.rationale: Customer spending values match, but the aggregate alias differs.
classifications.generated_sql: SELECT Customer.CustomerId, Customer.FirstName, Customer.LastName, ROUND(SUM(Invoice.Total), 2) AS total_spent FROM Customer JOIN Invoice ON Invoice.CustomerId = Customer.CustomerId GROUP BY Customer.CustomerId, Customer.FirstName, Customer.LastName HAVING SUM(Invoice.Total) > 40 ORDER BY total_spent DESC LIMIT 100

classifications.question: Show five tracks whose composer is not recorded.
classifications.rationale: Five qualifying tracks requested without defining which five.
classifications.generated_sql: SELECT TrackId, Name FROM Track WHERE Composer IS NULL LIMIT 5
expected_rows: (I Can't Help) Falling In Love With You
actual_rows: Samba De Uma Nota Só (One Note Samba)

classifications.question: Show the five customers with the most invoices, including their invoice counts.
classifications.rationale: Several customers tie at seven invoices; tie-breaking is unspecified.
classifications.generated_sql: SELECT Customer.CustomerId, Customer.FirstName, Customer.LastName, COUNT(Invoice.InvoiceId) AS invoice_count FROM Customer LEFT JOIN Invoice ON Invoice.CustomerId = Customer.CustomerId GROUP BY Customer.CustomerId, Customer.FirstName, Customer.LastName ORDER BY invoice_count DESC, Customer.LastName, Customer.FirstName LIMIT 5

classifications.question: Which customers live in Canada?
classifications.rationale: Correct Canadian customers, but row order differs.
classifications.generated_sql: SELECT CustomerId, FirstName, LastName, City FROM Customer WHERE Country = 'Canada' LIMIT 100

classifications.question: Which five artists generated the most revenue from sold tracks?
classifications.rationale: Artist and revenue values match; the revenue alias differs.
classifications.generated_sql: SELECT Artist.Name AS artist, ROUND(SUM(InvoiceLine.UnitPrice * InvoiceLine.Quantity), 2) AS total_revenue FROM Artist JOIN Album ON Artist.ArtistId = Album.ArtistId JOIN Track ON Album.AlbumId = Track.AlbumId JOIN InvoiceLine ON Track.TrackId = InvoiceLine.TrackId GROUP BY Artist.ArtistId, Artist.Name ORDER BY total_revenue DESC, Artist.Name LIMIT 5

classifications.question: Show five tracks that have never appeared on an invoice.
classifications.rationale: Five qualifying tracks requested without defining which five.
classifications.generated_sql: SELECT TrackId, Name FROM Track WHERE NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM InvoiceLine WHERE InvoiceLine.TrackId = Track.TrackId) ORDER BY TrackId LIMIT 5
expected_rows: "Eine Kleine Nachtmusik" Serenade In G, K. 525: I. Allegro
(I Can't Help) Falling In Love With You
